title: Final Implementation Hardening 025
hardeningLaws: Gameplay assembly never references Presentation, Save, Platform, UnityEngine, or UnityEditor.
Campaign 022 content contracts live in the pure Gameplay assembly.
Campaign 022 resource loading remains presentation-owned through ICampaignRegistry022.
Only one M2 battle resolver and one Forecast authority exist.
Only the existing deterministic equipment reward may create battle equipment.
Save format 11 and its migration chain remain authoritative.
Boot.unity is the first enabled build scene.
StreamingAssets contains runtime authority for built-player startup.
No compile or test failure may be packaged as an owner-review build.
No individual-member Art selection appears in Standard mode.
Ten allied and ten enemy Union positions remain supported.
No runtime generative AI or network content dependency is allowed.
